title: Lovely Roasted Ethiopian Chestnut Mushroom Fir Fir
description: A pungent and crispy Ethiopian dish featuring roasted chestnut mushrooms, perfect for meal prep. This nut-free-friendly recipe is a twist on the traditional fir fir dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced mushrooms with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the mushrooms on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a large skillet, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Stir in the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the roasted mushrooms, torn injera bread, and lemon juice to the skillet, and stir to combine.
Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes, or until the bread is crispy and the mixture is heated through.
Serve the fir fir hot, garnished with additional lemon juice and berbere spice if desired.
